name: amfx-us-federal-debt-research
description: amFX reproduction (09FEB24 p2, Panel 4): US Federal Debt Held by the Public ($T), 2013-2024. Part of the Mehlman Consulting 'polycrisis' dashboard. Shows accelerating federal debt growth from ~$12T (2013) to ~$29T (2024), with a massive step-up during COVID (2020). Data: FRED FYGFDPUN (quarterly, millions) converted to trillions + FYGFGDQ188S (debt as % GDP). Original chart extended to 2028 with CBO projections; this reproduction covers available actuals only.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: US FEDERAL DEBT HELD BY THE PUBLIC (09FEB24 p2, Panel 4)
# =============================================================================
# Part of the Mehlman Consulting four-panel polycrisis dashboard.
# FYGFDPUN: Federal Debt Held by the Public, quarterly, in millions.
# =============================================================================

debt_src = economic_indicators(series_id='FYGFDPUN')()
debt_filled = ffill(debt_src.result)

# Convert millions to trillions
debt_trillions = debt_filled / 1000000.0

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='US Federal Debt Held by the Public: The $29 Trillion Question',
    category='Polycrisis Dashboard',
    y_axis_label='Debt ($T)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Federal Debt ($T)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=17.0, title='Pre-COVID ~$17T', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=22.0, title='Post-COVID ~$22T', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=debt_trillions)
